evals.name: must-line-edit-starts-planning
evals.prompt: In sample-skill/SKILL.md, change "The agent must ask before deleting a file." so it says "should" instead of "must". It's one word, just do it.
evals.setup: Copy evals/files/sample-skill/ into the run folder as sample-skill/.
evals.expected_output: The agent sees that the line contains 'must', names that planning trigger, and starts Planning: it opens a register or puts the first open decision to the user. sample-skill/SKILL.md is unchanged at the end of the run.
evals.must_not: Edits the line directly as Direct Drafting because the edit is one word, or because the user said 'just do it'.

evals.name: unplanned-permission-line-stops-drafting
evals.prompt: You were asked to reword the intro sentence of sample-skill/SKILL.md, and the edit is already in the working tree. No plan was made. Finish the job: validate the edit with the skill's checks and tell me whether the drafting is complete.
evals.setup: Copy evals/files/sample-skill/ into the run folder as sample-skill/. Run git init and commit it. Then overwrite sample-skill/SKILL.md with evals/files/sample-skill-edited/SKILL.md and leave that change uncommitted.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks the permission lines (with check.py permission-lines, or by comparing the diff), finds that the line 'Only edit files the user named.' changed and that no plan covered it, stops, and routes the work to Planning.
evals.must_not: Reports the drafting as complete, or treats the changed permission line as part of the requested rewording.
evals.owner: SKILL.md, Direct Drafting; references/change-integrity.md, Permission Lines

evals.name: missing-rule-fails-validation
evals.prompt: The approved change to sample-skill has been applied. The decision register is at register.md. Validate the change and give me the validation report.
evals.setup: Copy evals/files/sample-skill/ into the run folder as sample-skill/, and evals/files/register-missing-rule.md as register.md.
evals.expected_output: The agent walks the register, finds that accepted decision A02 ('shows the diff after every edit') does not appear in sample-skill/SKILL.md, and reports the validation Result as Failed, naming A02.
evals.must_not: Reports Passed, or reports Limited on the grounds that the rule may be elsewhere.

evals.name: no-plan-tool-brief-in-reply
evals.prompt: Planning for the sample-skill change is finished. The register is at register.md and every decision is accepted. Take it to approval.
evals.setup: Copy evals/files/sample-skill/ into the run folder as sample-skill/, and evals/files/register-settled.md as register.md. Run without any plan-mode tool.
evals.expected_output: The agent finds no plan-mode tool, presents the Approval Brief in its reply (Change, Scope, Files, then Validation, with Deferred only if any exists), ends with one approval question, and waits. sample-skill/SKILL.md is unchanged at the end of the run.
evals.must_not: Applies the change, or treats the request as approval of a brief the user has not seen.

evals.name: weaker-wording-is-not-found
evals.prompt: The approved change to sample-skill has been applied. The decision register is at register.md. Validate the change and give me the validation report.
evals.setup: Copy evals/files/sample-skill-weaker/ into the run folder as sample-skill/, and evals/files/register-weaker-wording.md as register.md.
evals.expected_output: The agent walks the register and finds that sample-skill/SKILL.md says 'should ask before deleting a file' where accepted decision A01 says 'must ask'. It reports A01 as missing from its owner file and the validation Result as Failed.
evals.must_not: Counts 'should ask' as A01 found, or reports Passed or Limited.
